description:
Job description:

**Job Title:** Architect  
**Reports To:** Director

**Job Summary:**

The Architect will play a crucial role in designing and executing tile layouts, showcasing innovative applications of tile products in architectural spaces, and collaborating with clients, design teams, and contractors. This position requires creative and technical expertise in architectural design, combined with an in-depth understanding of tile products and applications. The Architect will also provide design solutions tailored to client needs while ensuring adherence to quality and aesthetic standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Design and Concept Development:**

* Create innovative tile-based **designs, layouts, and patterns** for various residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their requirements and develop **customized design concepts**.
* Integrate tile products into architectural designs, focusing on functionality, aesthetics, and durability.

**2. Project Coordination:**

* Work closely with **project managers, contractors, and interior designers** to ensure seamless execution of tile installations.
* Provide **technical guidance** on tile specifications, usage, and application methods during project planning.
* Conduct **site visits** to evaluate progress and ensure that tile designs are executed as per the approved plans.

**3. Product Expertise and Consultation:**

* Gain in-depth knowledge of the company’s tile product portfolio, including materials, finishes, textures, and dimensions.
* Advise clients and internal teams on **tile selection** based on project requirements, such as durability, maintenance, and design compatibility.
* Stay updated on **trends in architecture and tile design**, incorporating innovative ideas into projects.

**4. Technical Drawings and Documentation:**

* Prepare detailed **2D and 3D architectural drawings** and renderings using design software like AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or similar tools.
* Develop technical documentation, including **material specifications, cutting layouts, and installation guides** for tiles.
* Ensure that all drawings and designs comply with **building codes, safety standards,** and regulations.

**5. Client Interaction and Presentation:**

* Present design concepts and tile solutions to clients, incorporating their feedback into revisions.
* Develop compelling **visual presentations** and mood boards to demonstrate the creative application of tiles.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to support **client pitches** and design consultations.

**6. Quality Assurance:**

* Ensure that tile designs and installations meet **quality standards** in terms of alignment, grout lines, and overall finish.
* Identify and troubleshoot design or installation challenges during the project lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree** in Architecture or a related field.
* **01- 3 years of experience** in architectural design,
* Professional proficiency in design software, including **AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, 3ds Max,** or equivalent.

**Key Skills:**

* Strong understanding of **architectural principles** and interior design aesthetics.
* Expertise in **tile usage** for floors, walls, facades, and other applications.
* Proficiency in creating **technical drawings, renderings,** and visualizations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Creative problem-solving abilities to overcome design and technical challenges.

**Personal Attributes:**

* Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and precision.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Passion for design and innovation.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work in a team environment.

**Working Conditions:**

* The role is mainly office-based, with occasional site visits to project locations as required.
* Full-time role, with flexibility for extended hours based on project deadlines.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Health insurance and additional employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

**Job Description: AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Designation:** AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist  
**Experience:** 2–4 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on, AI-enabled Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist to strengthen brand visibility, audience engagement, and digital marketing performance across social media platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end content production, including video shooting, video editing, graphic design, creative content development, social media scheduling, organic promotion, paid campaign coordination, and performance reporting.

The role requires someone who can transform business updates, product information, industry insights, expert inputs, and internal marketing materials into engaging digital content using a combination of creative skills, AI tools, and data-driven marketing practices.

The candidate must be comfortable coordinating with internal teams, subject-matter experts, and management to collect information, obtain approvals, maintain consistent brand messaging, and deliver content that supports business and marketing objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Video Shooting & Production — Primary Responsibility**

* Plan, shoot, and produce short-form and long-form videos for social media, websites, campaigns, and business promotions.
* Independently handle video shooting using smartphones, cameras, microphones, lighting equipment, and other available production tools.
* Record interviews, expert discussions, product demonstrations, company updates, educational videos, behind-the-scenes content, and promotional videos.
* Plan video concepts, scripts, storyboards, shot lists, and production schedules.
* Edit videos with appropriate cuts, subtitles, captions, transitions, graphics, voiceovers, music, and brand elements.
* Create platform-specific video formats, including vertical short-form videos, reels, shorts, and landscape videos.
* Use AI-assisted video tools for captioning, transcription, background cleanup, audio enhancement, translation, resizing, and editing efficiency.
* Ensure videos are technically sound, visually appealing, factually accurate, and consistent with the approved brand identity.
* Maintain an organised library of raw footage, edited videos, source files, and approved final assets.

**B. Graphic Design & Creative Content Production**

* Design social media posts, carousels, infographics, promotional creatives, banners, thumbnails, event creatives, and campaign materials.
* Convert internal documents, product information, research findings, testimonials, case studies, and expert insights into visually engaging marketing assets.
* Create graphics that simplify technical, scientific, and business information for relevant audiences.
* Use design tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, or equivalent applications.
* Use AI-assisted design tools to generate creative concepts, visual variations, layouts, and supporting assets.
* Verify all AI-generated visuals and text for accuracy, licensing considerations, brand suitability, and misleading representations.
* Maintain consistent typography, colour palettes, logos, visual styles, and messaging across channels.
* Prepare multiple creative formats and dimensions for different platforms.

**C. AI-Powered Content Creation**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and suitable image, audio, and video tools to support ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing, and campaign development.
* Develop video scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, calls to action, hashtags, and content variations.
* Repurpose a single approved source into multiple assets, such as a video, carousel, infographic, LinkedIn post, newsletter visual, and short-form clip.
* Create AI-assisted content workflows and reusable prompts to improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Fact-check claims, statistics, technical statements, testimonials, and AI-generated information before publication.
* Ensure content is original, audience-focused, natural, and aligned with the organisation's expertise and positioning.
* Avoid fabricated customer stories, misleading synthetic visuals, unverified claims, and unauthorised use of personal likenesses or voices.

**D. Social Media Content Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain a monthly social media content calendar aligned with marketing priorities, campaigns, launches, events, and industry developments.
* Plan content themes, formats, publication dates, channels, target audiences, and calls to action.
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other business-relevant channels.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect updates, footage, product information, expert inputs, and campaign requirements.
* Ensure all posts follow brand guidelines, platform specifications, and internal approval procedures.
* Maintain a publishing tracker containing content status, approval records, scheduled dates, live URLs, and performance results.
* Ensure consistent posting while prioritising quality, relevance, and audience needs.

**E. Social Media Promotion & Audience Engagement**

* Promote published content through appropriate organic distribution strategies and relevant professional communities.
* Identify suitable industry groups, partner pages, expert networks, and audience segments for legitimate content distribution.
* Coordinate approved paid social campaigns with the marketing lead when required.
* Monitor comments, shares, messages, mentions, and audience feedback.
* Respond to routine audience interactions within approved communication guidelines and escalate business enquiries, complaints, or sensitive issues to the relevant team.
* Encourage meaningful engagement through educational content, expert perspectives, interactive posts, polls, and question-led formats.
* Coordinate with internal teams to amplify relevant company updates and approved campaigns.
* Avoid fake engagement, automated spam, purchased followers, and misleading engagement tactics.

**F. Platform-Specific Content Strategy**

* **LinkedIn:** Develop professional posts, industry insights, expert clips, company updates, carousels, thought-leadership content, and B2B campaign assets.
* **Instagram:** Create reels, stories, carousels, behind-the-scenes videos, and visually engaging educational content where relevant.
* **YouTube:** Produce educational videos, expert interviews, explainers, product demonstrations, and Shorts.
* **Other relevant channels:** Adapt content to audience behaviour and business objectives rather than publishing identical content everywhere.
* Optimise captions, titles, thumbnails, descriptions, hashtags, and calls to action according to platform best practices.

**G. Social Media Analytics & Engagement Reporting**

* Track content performance using native platform analytics and relevant reporting tools.
* Monitor reach, impressions, views, watch time, average viewing duration, completion rate, engagement rate, shares, saves, comments, profile visits, link clicks, and audience growth where available.
* Track website traffic, leads, enquiries, and conversions attributable to social campaigns where measurement is available.
* Identify top-performing content, underperforming formats, audience preferences, and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular reviews of posting times, creative formats, hooks, video lengths, and calls to action.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports with screenshots, live URLs, metrics, comparisons, insights, and recommended actions.
* Distinguish organic performance from paid campaign results and report the measurement period and platform accurately.
* Use performance insights to refine the next content calendar and improve engagement quality over time.

**H. Internal Coordination & Brand Governance**

* Coordinate with Business Development, Sales, Product, Research, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations teams to collect content inputs.
* Obtain testimonials, case studies, expert commentary, product updates, customer insights, and event materials.
* Convert the collected inputs into publication-ready visual and video content.
* Obtain management approval before publishing external content, following the organisation's established approval process.
* Ensure brand positioning, terminology, claims, and visual identity remain consistent.
* Obtain consent and necessary permissions before publishing customer testimonials, interviews, identifiable individuals, or confidential business information.
* Maintain records of source materials, approvals, final creatives, publication links, and performance reports.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Digital Marketing, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in digital content production and social media marketing, preferably supported by a portfolio.
* Hands-on video shooting, editing, graphic design, and creative content production skills.

* Ability to work independently from content planning through production, publishing, and reporting.

* Monitor conventional SEO performance through Google Search Console and other available analytics tools.
* Prepare periodic AI visibility reports using a consistent set of prompts, queries, platforms, and observation dates.

**H. Keyword & Content Performance Monitoring**

* Maintain a keyword and topic tracker covering target keywords, search intent, content status, rankings, and visibility trends.
* Identify content gaps and new opportunities through keyword research, competitor analysis, industry questions, and customer-facing team inputs.

* Maintain trackers for content requests, source-material collection, drafting, review, approval, publication, and performance.
* Report the number of assets created, articles submitted and published, expert interviews completed, newsletters delivered, and LinkedIn posts published.

The Hospital Marketing \& Sales professional is responsible for increasing patient footfall, building referral networks, promoting hospital services, and strengthening the hospital’s brand presence in the community. The role involves both field marketing and strategic planning.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Business Development \& Patient Acquisition**

* Develop and implement marketing strategies to increase OPD \& IP admissions
* Identify new business opportunities and partnerships
* Generate leads through camps, corporate tie\-ups, and community outreach programs
* Promote specialty services (e.g., dialysis, surgery packages, health check\-ups)

**2\. Doctor \& Referral Management**

* Build strong relationships with referring doctors, clinics, and hospitals
* Regular visits to general practitioners (GPs) and consultants
* Maintain referral database and track conversions

**3\. Corporate \& Institutional Tie\-ups**

* Establish tie\-ups with corporates, insurance companies, and TPAs
* Organize health camps, check\-ups, and awareness programs in companies
* Handle empanelment processes

**4\. Branding \& Promotions**

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns (online \& offline)
* Coordinate with digital marketing teams for social media, website, and ads
* Manage hospital branding, hoardings, brochures, and promotional materials

**5\. Market Research \& Competitor Analysis**

* Analyze competitor hospitals’ services, pricing, and strategies
* Identify market trends and patient preferences
* Suggest improvements in services and pricing

**6\. Patient Relationship Management**

* Ensure patient satisfaction and feedback collection
* Handle escalations related to marketing or service expectations
* Improve patient retention and loyalty programs

**7\. Reporting \& MIS**

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly marketing reports
* Track ROI of campaigns and activities
* Maintain records of leads, conversions, and revenue generated

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Negotiation and relationship\-building ability
* Knowledge of healthcare services and hospital operations
* Sales\-driven mindset with target orientation
* Basic understanding of digital marketing

**Qualifications**

* MBA / Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management
* 1–5 years experience for Executive role
* 5\+ years experience for Manager role (preferably in hospital/healthcare industry)

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Increase in OPD/IP numbers
* Number of corporate tie\-ups and referrals
* Revenue generation from marketing activities
* Patient satisfaction scores
* Brand visibility and engagement

**Working Conditions**

* Field work \+ hospital\-based role
* Flexible working hours (including camps/events on weekends if required)

title: Marketing Manager - B2B IT Services
description:
**Are you an experienced B2B IT Services marketing professional looking to lead marketing initiatives, drive demand generation, and build impactful campaigns that contribute to business growth?**


Join **LevelShift** as a **Marketing Manager**, where you'll be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing integrated marketing campaigns across content, digital, email, social media, SEO/AEO, PPC, and lead generation. You'll lead a team of marketing professionals and work closely with business stakeholders, sales, content, design, and digital marketing teams to deliver measurable marketing outcomes.


**What You'll Do**

  

  

As a **Marketing Manager** at LevelShift, you will:


* Lead and manage a team of **Content Writers and Marketing Executives** to achieve campaign objectives and business targets.
* Own and execute the **marketing calendar and campaign plan** in alignment with organizational and business priorities.
* Plan, coordinate, and monitor integrated **B2B marketing campaigns** across email, social media, PPC, SEO/AEO, content marketing, and publications.
* Drive end\-to\-end campaign execution, including **campaign planning, content development, creative coordination, publishing, promotion, performance tracking, and optimization**.
* Review campaign performance regularly and drive **course corrections based on campaign data, engagement, lead quality, and conversion trends**.
* Partner with the **design team** to develop campaign creatives, marketing collateral, digital assets, and content required for campaign execution.
* Work closely with the **digital marketing team** to drive SEO/AEO, paid marketing, website optimization, and digital campaign performance.
* Own and manage the **content calendar**, ensuring timely development and publication of high\-quality in\-house and outsourced content.
* Monitor and maintain **websites, social media channels, landing pages, and other digital marketing assets**.
* Lead and guide the **lead generation team** in identifying relevant target accounts, prospects, and contacts for various campaigns.
* Establish campaign objectives, monitor KPIs, analyze performance, and identify opportunities to improve **marketing effectiveness and ROI**.
* Work closely with **sales and business stakeholders** to understand business priorities and align marketing campaigns with lead\-generation and pipeline objectives.
* Manage multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously while ensuring **quality, timelines, and campaign deliverables** are met.
* Establish and maintain marketing processes, quality standards, and operating practices across the team.
* Track and review team activities, campaign progress, and individual performance against defined targets.
* Conduct regular **team meetings, performance reviews, feedback sessions, and best\-practice discussions**.
* Mentor and develop team members through **performance improvement, capability building, and continuous learning**.
* Provide floor support and respond to **prospect enquiries** when required.
* Monitor team engagement and take proactive measures to support **employee retention and team stability**.
* Prepare and present regular **marketing performance, campaign, lead\-generation, and team status reports** to the reporting manager.
* Identify and implement **process improvements** to enhance marketing efficiency, campaign execution, and overall team productivity.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **information security policies, organizational processes, and quality standards**.
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**


* Should be comfortable using **AI tools** to improve marketing strategy, campaign planning, content development, market research, analytics, and team productivity while ensuring responsible AI usage.
* Utilize AI\-assisted tools for **content creation, campaign ideation, SEO/AEO optimization, audience research, lead generation, personalization, reporting, and campaign analysis**.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as **ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and other GenAI and marketing technology platforms** to accelerate marketing execution.
* Explore opportunities to use AI for **customer segmentation, account research, content personalization, campaign optimization, lead qualification, and marketing analytics**.
* Encourage the marketing team to adopt AI responsibly while maintaining **data privacy, information security, brand guidelines, and organizational standards**.
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve **marketing workflows, campaign performance, content operations, reporting, and team productivity**.
  

  

**Your Skillset**


* **10\+ years of experience** in B2B marketing, preferably within the **IT Services, Technology, SaaS, or enterprise technology industry**, with proven experience in a managerial or leadership role.
* Strong understanding of **B2B IT Services marketing**, enterprise technology marketing, and demand\-generation strategies.
* Proven experience planning and executing **integrated marketing campaigns** across email, social media, PPC, SEO/AEO, content marketing, and digital channels.
* Strong knowledge of **SEO and AEO** and their application within B2B marketing.
* Experience managing **marketing technology platforms and tools** used for campaign execution, automation, analytics, lead generation, and content management.
* Strong **analytical mindset** with the ability to interpret campaign performance, lead\-generation metrics, engagement, conversion, and other marketing KPIs.
* Experience managing **content strategy, content calendars, content development, and publishing activities**.
* Strong experience coordinating with **content, design, digital marketing, lead generation, sales, and business teams**.
* Proven experience in **team management, mentoring, performance management, capability building, and target management**.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance and drive **data\-driven course corrections and optimization**.
* Strong understanding of **lead generation, target account identification, demand generation, prospect engagement, and campaign\-driven pipeline creation**.
* Strong **project management and deadline\-management skills**, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities.
* Excellent **stakeholder management, communication, presentation, leadership, analytical, and problem\-solving skills**.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-oriented, and collaborative environment.
* Strong focus on **quality, process compliance, information security, and operational excellence**.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with **B2B marketing, digital marketing, SEO/AEO, marketing technology, AI, and emerging marketing trends**.
  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


* Lead impactful **B2B IT Services marketing and demand\-generation initiatives** that contribute to business growth.
* Own and influence marketing strategy across **content, digital, email, social media, SEO/AEO, PPC, and lead generation**.
* Work closely with **sales, business leaders, technology teams, content, design, and digital marketing professionals**.
* Build and mentor a high\-performing marketing team while developing strong **leadership and strategic marketing capabilities**.
* Gain exposure to modern **marketing technology, AI\-powered tools, digital platforms, and data\-driven marketing practices**.
* Drive continuous improvement in **campaign performance, lead generation, brand visibility, and marketing effectiveness**.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, professional development programs, and exposure to emerging **marketing and AI technologies**.

title: Creative Head
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Creative Manager to join our team and work closely with the evolving Maarrs product

portfolio.

This is not a conventional Creative Manager role.

The role combines hands\-on creative production, design execution, video creation, team formation and

leadership, and UI/UX quality oversight, and will require the individual to work across different creative

aspects of the product and business.

As an early\-stage startup, we believe that roles cannot always be restricted to a fixed job description.

Everyone is expected to contribute wherever required, take ownership and help build the organisation and

product.

Most importantly, we are not looking for someone who already knows everything.

Creative tools, production techniques, product knowledge and new AI\-enabled creative capabilities can all be

learned and developed over time. What is much harder to teach is attitude, ownership, work ethic, curiosity,

adaptability and willingness to learn and contribute.

That is what we value most.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who:**

 Has a strong work ethic and takes ownership of commitments.

 Has a genuine willingness to work and contribute, rather than waiting to be told what to do.

 Is curious and has a willingness to explore, question and understand.

 Is willing to learn new creative skills, tools and ways of working.

 Can operate comfortably in an environment where things are still being built and refined.

 Is flexible and adaptable when priorities or responsibilities change.

 Can work across creative functions rather than being restricted by a narrow job description.

 Is comfortable taking responsibility for something and following it through to completion.

 Can think beyond the immediate creative task and understand where the product and brand are heading in the

future.

 Wants to build their own capabilities and career alongside the growth of the product and organisation.

 Has good professional ethics, reliability and discipline.

 Can work independently while also collaborating effectively with others.

 Brings structure and clarity even when the situation itself is not completely structured.

The role will broadly operate across creative production, design, video and creative team management:

 Work closely with the CEO on creative execution and production priorities.

 Build, develop and lead the creative team across design and video functions, with hands\-on creative

production remaining a core responsibility.

 Oversee the UI/UX and front\-end design department — reviewing and ensuring quality of output, not hands\-on

execution.

 Drive creative marketing ideas and campaign concepts.

 Create and execute end\-to\-end video production, including 2D animation, 3D animation, motion graphics,

AI\-generated video and video editing, while also overseeing the quality and delivery of video outputs.

 Design and oversee brand assets including logos, posters, full branding kits, letterheads and marketing

collateral.

 Manage design and video workflows from brief to final delivery across multiple concurrent projects.

 Maintain production quality and ensure creative outputs are delivered to the required standard and within

agreed timelines.

 Coordinate creative priorities across multiple projects and ensure that agreed actions are followed through to

completion.

 Provide creative direction and quality review while remaining hands\-on where production execution is required.

**Creative Skills \& Experience**

The following would be advantageous, with strong practical proficiency expected for the core production tools:

 Adobe Premiere Pro.

 Adobe After Effects.

 Adobe Photoshop.

 Adobe Illustrator.

 DaVinci Resolve (color grading).

 Canva (professional\-level use).

 Figma (UI/UX design).

 2D animation and motion graphics.

 3D animation.

 AI video generation tools.

 Video editing and post\-production.

 Brand identity design, including logos, letterheads and full branding systems.

 Poster and marketing collateral design.

 UI/UX oversight and quality review of application design and front\-end output.

 Creative team leadership and creative workflow management.

Added advantage (not mandatory):

 Pre\-production experience, including script writing.

 Cinematography knowledge — camera positioning, shot composition, and the ability to advise across

production departments.

A strong portfolio demonstrating expert\-level execution across design AND video disciplines simultaneously is

important. Proven experience leading a creative team, working directly with executive leadership, and

independently managing multiple creative workflows end\-to\-end would be advantageous.
